description: Get the employer's application link for a job, once the user has decided to apply. Some employers ask screening questions first: the reply then lists them instead of the link, and you call again with the user's own answers in screening_answers (never guess or invent an answer). It returns the link when the answers meet the employer's requirements, and no link when they don't. Uses the connected Himalayas account (no extra sign-in needed); limited to 50 links per account per day. Use the company_slug and job_slug from job listings.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL or company page)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

screening_answers.description: The user's answers to this job's screening questions, only after a reply listed them

answer.description: true/false for yes/no questions, one of the listed options, or the user's own short text

question_id.description: The question's ID from the screening questions

name: get_apply_link
title: Get apply link
